Bron: 21 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.

De bijbehorende borg wordt, na verwerking, teruggestort
Bron: Inleveren_Abbonementborg_A5.pdf p1 (CMYK; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 148 x 105 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 154 x 111 mm.

Variabelen: title = Bewijs van inlevering / toegangsmiddel; body-1 = ParkingYou bevestigt hierbij de ontvangst van he; body-2 = De bijbehorende borg wordt, na verwerking, terug; customer-name-label = Naam klant:; line-length = 83.5 mm; signature-label = Handtekening klant
Tekstcorrectie in template: "toegangs-/middel (manual hyphenation across two lines)" wordt "toegangsmiddel (word whole, paragraph reflowed to three lines)" (referentie houdt het origineel).
Tekstcorrectie in template: "Datum (trailing space)" wordt "Datum (no trailing space, right aligned to the end of the date field)" (referentie houdt het origineel).
Tekstcorrectie in template: "Naam klant: ______ (typed underscores)" wordt "Naam klant: plus a drawn navy rule of the same length (py-comp-field-line-label)" (referentie houdt het origineel).

The file is named A5 but the page is 148 x 105 mm (A6 landscape). No bleed in the source; the template has 3 mm bleed (white). Open question for the owner: the running text spells the brand 'ParkingYou' (capital P and Y) while the logo is set 'parkingyou'; kept as in the source, not changed. Reflow: with the word 'toegangsmiddel' whole, line 2 no

longer fits in the text width, so paragraph 1 is set in three lines (leading 1.2 x 4.59 mm = 5.5 mm, as in the source) and the gap to paragraph 2 is 8.0 mm instead of 11.0 mm so the lower block (Naam klant, signature box) stays where it is in the source.
